relation_families.info: metadata projection with exact executable declarations/binding preserved; specification meaning is a separate consumer obligation
relation_families.typecheck: well-formedness plus justified lifetime unification; this implementation check is not a semantic certificate
relation_families.generic: environment/dictionary/substitution relation preserving all call targets, trait laws and effect dependencies
relation_families.storage: state relation preserving local liveness, initialization, moves and borrow permissions, or a proved erasure condition
relation_families.drop: effect relation preserving destructor/drop-glue/cleanup execution and bad prefixes; a no-destructor premise must be justified
relation_families.cfg: finite-prefix control-flow simulation preserving branch guards, exits, bad steps and evaluation order; progress additionally for liveness
relation_families.constant: value and initializer relation preserving failure, initialization, target width and compile-time origin
relation_families.pointer: pointer/value relation preserving metadata, provenance, access authority and source failure; layout facts alone insufficient
relation_families.arith: outcome-sensitive scalar relation with exact width/mode/guard correspondence; failure cannot disappear
relation_families.effects: call/environment relation including allocation, custom allocator and external effects
relation_families.value: value relation plus erased-state/frame obligations; successful-value equality alone insufficient
